name: SocialBee
summary: Social media management and scheduling with content categories. Plan, recycle and publish posts across all your channels from one calendar.
best_for: solo marketers and small agencies who post to several networks on a schedule and want evergreen recycling rather than a queue that empties
skip_if: you post to one or two networks by hand and are happy doing it, because the value here is category-based recycling across many profiles and that only pays back at volume
honest_knock: You are billed per social profile, not per person, and a profile is one brand account on one network. A single business posting to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and TikTok has used the whole Bootstrap allowance before a second brand or a client exists. The second thing is that people cost extra on top: Bootstrap and Accelerate are single-user plans, so a two-person team on eight profiles is $49 plus $10, not $29. Count your profiles across every network first — that number, not your team size, decides the tier.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on socialbee.com/pricing/; every named-plan amount unchanged to the cent. The yearly figures render as a monthly equivalent -- $24.20, $40.80 and $82.50 for Bootstrap, Accelerate and Pro. Header terms: free 14-day trial, no contracts, 30-day money-back guarantee, and the trial gives full Pro access without a card. Analytics history is capped at 3 months on Bootstrap against 2 years on every tier above it; content categories run 10 / 50 / unlimited and content sources 10 / 30 / unlimited. The add-on prices below were read on 30 Aug and are no longer on the pricing page, which now routes you into the app to buy them) Bootstrap $29/month ($290 a year, 16% off): 5 profiles, 1 workspace, 1 user. Accelerate $49/month ($490 a year): 10 profiles, 1 workspace, 1 user. Pro $99/month ($990 a year): 25 profiles, 5 workspaces, 3 users per workspace. Agency tiers billed monthly: Pro50 $179, Pro100 $329, Pro150 $449 for 50, 100 and 150 profiles, with 10, 20 and 30 workspaces and 5 users per workspace; billed yearly they are $149.20, $274.20 and $374.20 a month. Add-ons: 5 extra profiles $15/month or $150/year, an extra user $10/month or $100/year, an extra workspace $10/month or $100/year. AI generation is unlimited on every tier.
